title: Crypto Trading Signals - April 04, 2026
top_story_headline: Senate Banking delays CLARITY Act text as industry reviews revised stablecoin yield compromise
top_story_comment: Coinbase pulled $1.3B from stablecoin rewards in 2025, and the current text basically kneecaps that entire revenue line by banning passive yield on balances. Meanwhile the "activity-based rewards" carve-out is so vaguely scoped that SEC/CFTC/Treasury get a full 12 months post-enactment to define what even qualifies — which means every major issuer is about to spend the next year engineering reward structures that technically tie to "transactions" or "platform use" while economically replicating interest. The real kicker is that a]16z and Ehrsam already blessed this compromise from inside the President's advisory council, so Coinbase and Stripe are fighting upstream against their own industry's appointed voices.
